description: Where Everyday Confidence Meets Everyday Adventure  Finished in Agate Black Metallic, this 2023 Ford Edge SEL AWD carries a presence that feels both sleek and confident from the moment it appears in the driveway. The deep black metallic finish emphasizes the Edges sculpted body lines while the 18-Inch Carbonized Gray Aluminum Wheels and bold styling elements from the Sport Appearance Package give the SUV a stance that looks just as comfortable cruising through Hudson, Pittsford, and Camden as it does handling the rhythm of daily travel across Livingston County, Kalamazoo County, and St. Joseph County.  Power comes from the responsive 2.0L EcoBoost Engine, paired with a refined 8-Speed Automatic Transmission that delivers smooth, balanced acceleration whenever the road opens ahead. Whether merging onto US-23, cruising along I-275, or following the winding stretches of M-66, the Edge moves with quiet confidence that makes long drives feel relaxed and controlled.  Step inside and the cabin reveals a space built to make every mile more comfortable. Acceleration arrives effortlessly as the road opens ahead, whether merging onto US-23, cruising across I-96, or following the scenic stretches of M-14. Cold mornings become far more comfortable thanks to Heated Front Seats and a Heated Steering Wheel, making winter commutes across the Midwest something you actually look forward to.  Above the cabin, the expansive Panoramic Fixed-Glass Roof fills the interior with natural light and creates a sense of openness that transforms every drive. Whether youre heading across town or taking a longer trip out of the city, the cabin feels bright, modern, and connected to the road ahead.  Technology is front and center throughout the Mach-E experience. The large SYNC® 4A system with a 15.5-inch touchscreen places navigation, media, and vehicle controls within easy reach, while FordPass Connect keeps you connected to your vehicle wherever you go. The B&O Sound System with 10 speakers fills the cabin with rich sound, and advanced driver technologies like BlueCruise hands-free highway driving and the 360-Degree Camera System add confidence and convenience when traveling or maneuvering through tight spaces.  Those journeys may lead across northwest Ohio through Archbold, Sandusky, and Whitehouse, crossing Fulton County, Erie County, and Wood County along US-20, I-90, and OH-64. Or the road may stretch west into Indiana through Angola, Garrett, and LaGrange, connecting Steuben County, DeKalb County, and LaGrange County along I-69, US-6, and IN-3. Multiple USB ports and Bluetooth connectivity help keep devices connected and charged.Safety & Driver Assistance:Cadillac equips the CT4 Premium Luxury with a suite of safety features and driver-assist technologies designed to enhance confidence behind the wheel.
